loader_primary_sources.finding: dladdr identifies the image containing a data address. Reopening the same resolved path increments its reference count. RTLD_NOLOAD refuses an absent image and acquires a counted handle for an existing image; NODELETE promises mapping retention.

A NOLOAD handle is reference counted. Search overrides may affect even full paths, so a self-path request still needs a same-image check. NODELETE is documented as address-space retention, not a C++ lifetime certificate.
Current upstream NOLOAD increments the count and returns before later NODELETE marking; combining flags must not be assumed to apply both effects.

Current upstream positive dlopen counts root an image and dependencies. Dead-image finalizers run before the later leaveMapped unmap exclusion. Mapping retention alone therefore does not establish live C++ registration state.
DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES is a supported preload route but changes startup loading/initializer order and can be ignored for protected processes.
